title: A deep learning-driven cataract screening model derived from multicenter real-world dataset
summary: A cascaded deep-learning system was trained on 22,094 slit-lamp images from 21 ophthalmic institutions across 12 Chinese provinces and municipalities. On an independent test set, a ResNet50-IBN model achieved 93.74% accuracy, 97.74% specificity and AUC 0.953 for cataract classification. The study does not report prospective screening outcomes.
ai_technology: Cascaded deep-learning screening model; ResNet50-IBN for cataract classification
organization: Department of Ophthalmology, The Second Affiliated Hospital of Anhui Medical University, Hefei, China; Institute of Digital Ophthalmology and Visual Science, Changsha Aier Eye Hospital, Changsha, China; Aier Academy of Ophthalmology, Central South University, Changsha, China

evidence.tested: The system assessed image quality, screened confounders and classified cataract, post-surgery, other ocular disease or healthy eyes. ResNet50-IBN reached 93.74% accuracy, 97.74% specificity and AUC 0.953 on the independent test set.
evidence.unknown: The held-out test is part of the study dataset; effects on prospective screening, referral decisions or patient outcomes are not established.
evidence.ai_role: Deep-learning models assessed image quality and confounders before classifying cataract and other eye states from slit-lamp images.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
